paragraphs.text: Yedora is a treefolk druid teacher at the Witherbloom College of Strixhaven University on Arcavios .

Yedora is a tall Treefolk who is as much plant as she is mammal. Her skin is bark brown, and her hair and hands are made up of twisting, gnarled roots. There is quiet strength and serenity in her presence.

Yedora is the head groundskeeper and unofficial undertaker of Strixhaven. Students and graduates often wish to spend their afterlife at their beloved university, and she happily honors that wish. Each tree she plants represents the essence of a fallen mage, and she remembers every one of their names.
Yedora fought in defense of Arcavios during the New Phyrexian Invasion . After the war, she was back at teaching classes on the importance of proper mana resonance in flower arranging.
